environment.description: Same EC2 instance running the Flask monolith on port 8080. Origin security group restricts inbound TCP/8080 to the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52). CloudFront distribution (E2XYZABC123) configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using custom header validation: X-Origin-Verify header with rotating secret checked by the application's nginx sidecar (returns 403 if header missing/wrong). CloudFront behaviors require signed URLs (Trusted Key Group kg-abc123def456) with RSA-SHA1 signature validation and 30-second URL expiry. CloudFront has a cache policy with TTL min=0, max=1, default=0 (effectively no caching of API responses). The signed URL policy restricts each URL to a single path and includes IP address condition matching the requester's IP. Rate-based rule in CloudFront Functions limits to 5 requests per second per IP with 60-second block duration on the /api/* path pattern.

config.origin_access_control: custom header X-Origin-Verify with rotating secret (rotated every 300s via Lambda)
